title: Minceraft+
description: A simple modpack designed to bring more content to vanilla Minecraft without going overboard.
body: This modpack contains a few vanilla+ mods to extend gameplay further. New terrain, more armor trims & weapon trims, 300+ advancements, distant horizons & iris support, and a few more! This modpack is intended to just extend the life of minecraft and provide a few more things to do.
